messages:
alex: morning all — quick async standup
alex: yesterday: landed kernel prefetch patch (PR #482), added metric for KV warmup hit-rate, ran small perf sweep on g5.2x
tara: nice! saw PR, left a couple nits on the CRC check. main question: do we need metrics for cold-start p95?
lee: yesterday: benchmarked microbatching change — p50 down ~8ms, p95 up ~20ms on a worst-case trace; looks like slot contention when concurrency spikes
morgan: blocker: observed KV eviction spike during heavy traffic in canary, need to tune `evict_threshold` for 512-slot pools
sam: today: iterate on prefetch backoff, will add gradual ramp to avoid stampede; also will open follow-up to add unhealthy node fallback
alex: note: bench command I used:

```
./bench --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --batcher=continuous --profile
```

alex: results uploaded to perf dashboard: https://perfdash.redwood.internal/run/480123 (summary: 8% cost drop, cold-start p95 regressed ~12%)
ci-bot: CI: PR #482 tests passed — 12/12, canary deploy scheduled at 03:00 UTC :rocket:
lee: FYI I mutated slot allocator to surface `slot_steal` tags in traces — will push small PR today
morgan: workaround for eviction: set `evict_threshold=0.85` on canary and monitor for 30m, rollback if p95 regresses
tara: code review ping @alex for the CRC nit, otherwise LGTM
alex: ack, will address nit today. planning to run extended bench overnight and report delta in morning
sam: ping @morgan re: logs — can you add the `evict_reason` field to the eviction metric? helps triage
morgan: yep adding `evict_reason` now, will also tag evictions with pool_id
alex: anything else? if not I’ll mark this thread resolved after bench uploads :+1:
lee: nothing else from me
tara: same
sam: 👍
ci-bot: deploy: canary to 2/10 hosts started
alex: thanks — keeping an eye, will call out if rollback needed
